rules: stage 1 preliminary summary is built from exact-date raw list plus latest news-theme analysis and does not wait for funding facts
stage 2 final summary is built from latest exact-date unified analysis and supersedes stage 1 while retaining news/theme semantics
all deterministic counts must be derived from exact-date repository data
missing historical dependencies must be reported as missing or partial and must never be replaced by adjacent-date data or numeric zero
theme aggregation uses explicit semantic tags normalized through the canonical taxonomy and must never infer a theme from price movement alone
AI narrative may interpret deterministic facts but must never override deterministic counts
final status requires latest unified analysis for the exact target date and complete per-stock analysis coverage
historical rebuilds always use the latest market summary methodology
latest rules overwrite historical analysis; old schema versions are not preserved for runtime use
news-theme analysis is a first-stage semantic source and never contains synthetic funding values
facts are deterministic and must not infer a catalyst from price movement alone
AI analyses must cover every stock in facts exactly once and in the same order
cause_tags must be unique lowercase snake_case ASCII identifiers
direct or corroborated evidence requires at least one public source URL
unknown and low_liquidity causes must use low confidence
published analysis merges deterministic flow and technical facts with AI semantic cause fields
when AI analysis is unavailable, deterministic fallback output must explicitly mark weak evidence and must not invent a public catalyst
